item.title: Baraka Performers to celebrate 10 years with “Because Of You” concert in April
item.description: Baraka Performers, a Ugandan dance group founded in 2017, will hold a two-day concert in April 2026 to celebrate 10 years of creative art, featuring powerful performances, a live band, and a cocktail setup. The post Baraka Performers to celebrate 10 years with “Because Of You” concert in April appeared first on MBU.
